name: Tom Baker
message: Hi, how much would it cost to automate our weekly sales report from Shopify into Google Sheets?
summary: Tom Baker asks about the cost of automating a weekly Shopify sales report into Google Sheets.

name: 李娜
message: 你好，我们想做一个自动整理客户表单的流程，大概多少钱？多久能做好？
summary: 客户咨询自动整理客户表单流程的价格和交付周期。

name: Maria Lopez
message: Do you offer monthly packages? We have about 300 support emails a week and want them sorted automatically.
summary: Maria Lopez asks whether monthly packages are offered for automatically sorting about 300 support emails per week.

name: 王强
message: 请问你们能帮我们搭建一个基于公司制度文件的问答机器人吗？想先了解一下报价。
summary: 客户咨询能否基于公司制度文件搭建问答机器人，并希望了解报价。

name: James Wu
message: The workflow you set up last month stopped sending notifications since yesterday. Can you take a look?
summary: The workflow set up last month has stopped sending notifications since yesterday and needs investigation.

name: 陈静
message: 上周交付的表格清洗工具，上传超过 5 万行的文件就报错，麻烦帮忙看一下。
summary: 客户反馈上周交付的表格清洗工具在上传超过5万行文件时报错，请求排查。

name: Anna Schmidt
message: How do I add a new person to the notification list? I couldn't find it in the instructions.
summary: Anna Schmidt asks how to add a new person to the notification list, as she couldn't find it in the instructions.

name: 刘洋
message: 问答机器人回答的时候没有显示页码了，是不是哪里设置改了？
summary: 用户反馈问答机器人回答时不再显示页码，询问是否是设置被更改。

name: Peter Hall
message: This is the third time the report arrived empty. We are paying for this and it is not acceptable.
summary: Customer reports the report has arrived empty for the third time and expresses dissatisfaction with the paid service.

name: 赵敏
message: 说好三天交付，现在已经一周了还没消息，非常不满意。
summary: 客户赵敏投诉承诺三天交付但已过一周仍无消息，表示非常不满意。

name: Laura Chen
message: Your invoice charged us twice this month. Please fix this immediately.
summary: Customer reports being charged twice on this month's invoice and demands an immediate fix.

name: 孙磊
message: 客服一直不回复，问题拖了很久都没解决，希望尽快给个说法。
summary: 客户投诉客服长期不回复，问题拖延未解决，要求尽快给出说法。

name: David Kim
message: I run a small marketing agency. Would you be open to a referral partnership for automation projects?
summary: David Kim of a small marketing agency asks whether we are open to a referral partnership for automation projects.

name: 周婷
message: 我们是做企业培训的，想和你们合作推出一门 AI 自动化课程，方便聊聊吗？
summary: 周婷希望就合作推出AI自动化课程进行洽谈。

name: Sofia Rossi
message: We build e-commerce sites and often need automation work. Could we subcontract projects to you?
summary: Sofia Rossi proposes subcontracting automation projects to us for her e-commerce site builds.

name: 吴刚
message: 我们公司有一批制造业客户需要知识库系统，想找长期技术合作伙伴。
summary: 吴刚代表公司寻求长期技术合作，为制造业客户提供知识库系统。

name: Lucky Winner
message: Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a free iPhone. Click the link to claim now!!!
summary: The message claims the recipient won a free iPhone and urges clicking a link to claim it, which is a classic spam/phishing pattern.

name: 推广专员
message: 低价出售各类平台账号、粉丝、好评，量大从优，加微信详谈。
summary: 该消息是推销平台账号、粉丝和好评的垃圾广告。

name: SEO Expert
message: I can get your website to page 1 of Google in 7 days, guaranteed. Reply for a special price.
summary: Unsolicited SEO service offer promising guaranteed page 1 Google rankings.

name: 网贷顾问
message: 无需抵押，秒批贷款，最高 50 万，点击链接立即申请。
summary: 该消息是无抵押快速贷款的推广广告，疑似垃圾信息。
